import json, pathlib, subprocess, tempfile; repo = pathlib.Path.cwd(); fz = repo / 'target/debug/fz'
root = pathlib.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='fozzylang-diagnostic-stability-'))
parser_src = root / 'parser_case.fzy'
grouped_src = root / 'grouped_case.fzy'
cap_src = root / 'cap_case.fzy'
parser_src.write_text('fn main( -> i32 {\n    return 0\n}\n')
grouped_src.write_text('fn main() -> i32 {\n    let value: i32 = "oops"\n    return value\n}\n')
cap_src.write_text('fn main() -> i32 {\n    discard proc.spawn("echo", list.new())\n    return 0\n}\n')
for key, family in [
    ('verifier.grouped_type_error', 'verifier'),
    ('native.cranelift_async_unsafe_unsupported', 'native-lowering'),
    ('verifier.extern_c_pointer_requires_contract', 'verifier')
]:
    proc = subprocess.run([str(fz), 'explain', key, '--json'], cwd=str(repo), capture_output=True, text=True)
    payload = json.loads(proc.stdout.strip())
    assert proc.returncode == 0, (proc.returncode, proc.stdout, proc.stderr)
    assert payload['schemaVersion'] == 'fozzylang.diagnostic_explain.v1', payload
    assert payload['catalogKey'] == key, payload
    assert payload['family'] == family, payload
    assert payload['explainCommand'] == f'fz explain {key}', payload
parser_proc = subprocess.run([str(fz), 'lsp', 'diagnostics', str(parser_src), '--json'], cwd=str(repo), capture_output=True, text=True)
parser_payload = json.loads(parser_proc.stdout.strip())
assert parser_proc.returncode == 0, (parser_proc.returncode, parser_proc.stdout, parser_proc.stderr)
parser_diag = next(item for item in parser_payload['diagnostics'] if item.get('catalog_key', '').startswith('parser.'))
assert parser_diag['catalog_key'].startswith('parser.'), parser_diag
grouped_proc = subprocess.run([str(fz), 'lsp', 'diagnostics', str(grouped_src), '--json'], cwd=str(repo), capture_output=True, text=True)
grouped_payload = json.loads(grouped_proc.stdout.strip())
assert grouped_proc.returncode == 0, (grouped_proc.returncode, grouped_proc.stdout, grouped_proc.stderr)
grouped_diag = next(item for item in grouped_payload['diagnostics'] if item.get('catalog_key') == 'verifier.grouped_type_error')
assert grouped_diag['catalog_key'] == 'verifier.grouped_type_error', grouped_diag
assert grouped_diag['help'], grouped_diag
cap_proc = subprocess.run([str(fz), 'lsp', 'diagnostics', str(cap_src), '--json'], cwd=str(repo), capture_output=True, text=True)
cap_payload = json.loads(cap_proc.stdout.strip())
assert cap_proc.returncode == 0, (cap_proc.returncode, cap_proc.stdout, cap_proc.stderr)
cap_diag = next(item for item in cap_payload['diagnostics'] if item.get('catalog_key') in ('verifier.missing_required_capability', 'verifier.function_missing_required_capability'))
assert cap_diag['catalog_key'] in ('verifier.missing_required_capability', 'verifier.function_missing_required_capability'), cap_diag
print('compiler-diagnostic-stability-ok')
